niche: free AI-powered SEO tool for websites: site audit, keyword ideas, competitor comparison, SEO articles
about_facts: UMA SEO AI is a free SEO agent that runs automatically every day on GitHub Actions
It audits a website's on-page SEO: title, meta description, headings, images, links, schema, robots.txt and sitemap
It measures speed with Google PageSpeed Insights
It finds keyword ideas from Google Autocomplete and uses Gemini AI to write articles, tags and an action plan
It compares the site with competitor websites on on-page SEO
It does not show competitor search volume or backlinks because that data is paid
A monitor checks the site every hour and rolls the site back to the last working version if it breaks
